verdict.rationale: The evidence shows PagerDuty offers Status Pages and describes them as a way to 'securely communicate' operational updates. Nothing in the pack documents private or internal status pages, audience-restricted access, or access controls for customer-specific or employee-only viewers. Generic public status pages are an adjacent feature, so the story's core capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can run private or internal status pages with access control for customer-specific or employee-only audiences
